name: dLocal Go
line: Self-serve payments, links and subscriptions for cross-border sellers.

free.text: No setup or monthly fee published; processing fees apply

cells.countries: US and India international-only; buyer-country limits apply
cells.payout: Up to 48 business hours after withdrawal approval

fee.math: US sellers can only accept payments from outside the US.
It isn't published whether UK sellers can sign up, and no UK card rate is listed in the seller lists or price list.
It isn't published whether German sellers can sign up, and no German card rate is listed in the seller lists or price list.
Indian sellers can only accept payments from outside India.
